texts.NIV84: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my sighing.
texts.KJV: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.
texts.NASB95:
Give ear to my words, O Lord,
Consider my groaning.
texts.NKJV:
Give ear to my words, O Lord,
Consider my meditation.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for her that obtaineth the inheritance. A psalm of David. Give ear, O Lord, to my words, understand my cry.
texts.ESV:
Give ear to my words, O Lord;
    consider my groaning.

texts.NIV84: Listen to my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
texts.KJV: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
texts.NASB95:
Heed the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God,
For to You I pray.
texts.NKJV:
Give heed to the voice of my cry,
My King and my God,
For to You I will pray.
texts.DRB: Hearken to the voice of my prayer, O my King and my God.
texts.ESV:
Give attention to the sound of my cry,
    my King and my God,
    for to you do I pray.

texts.NIV84: In the morning, O LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait in expectation.
texts.KJV: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
texts.NASB95:
In the morning, O Lord, You will hear my voice;
In the morning I will order my prayer to You and eagerly watch.
texts.DRB: For to thee will I pray: O Lord, in the morning thou shalt hear my voice.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, in the morning you hear my voice;
    in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch.

texts.NIV84: You are not a God who takes pleasure in evil; with you the wicked cannot dwell.
texts.KJV: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
texts.NASB95:
For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness;
No evil dwells with You.
texts.NKJV:
For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness,
Nor shall evil dwell with You.
texts.DRB: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.
texts.ESV:
For you are not a God who delights in wickedness;
    evil may not dwell with you.

texts.NIV84: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence; you hate all who do wrong.
texts.KJV: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
texts.NASB95:
The boastful shall not stand before Your eyes;
You hate all who do iniquity.
texts.NKJV:
The boastful shall not stand in Your sight;
You hate all workers of iniquity.
texts.DRB: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.
texts.ESV:
The boastful shall not stand before your eyes;
    you hate all evildoers.

texts.NIV84: You destroy those who tell lies; bloodthirsty and deceitful men the LORD abhors.
texts.KJV: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
texts.NASB95:
You destroy those who speak falsehood;
The Lord abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
texts.NKJV:
You shall destroy those who speak falsehood;
The Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
texts.DRB: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: Thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie. The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor.
texts.ESV:
You destroy those who speak lies;
    the Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

texts.NIV84: But I, by your great mercy, will come into your house; in reverence will I bow down toward your holy temple.
texts.KJV: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
texts.NASB95:
But as for me, by Your abundant lovingkindness I will enter Your house,
At Your holy temple I will bow in reverence for You.
texts.NKJV:
But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy;
In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.
texts.DRB: But as for me in the multitude of thy mercy, I will come into thy house; I will worship towards thy holy temple, in thy fear.
texts.ESV:
But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love,
    will enter your house.
I will bow down toward your holy temple
    in the fear of you.

texts.NIV84: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies- make straight your way before me.
texts.KJV: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, lead me in Your righteousness because of my foes;
Make Your way straight before me.
texts.NKJV:
Lead me, O Lord, in Your righteousness because of my enemies;
Make Your way straight before my face.
texts.DRB: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice: because of my enemies, direct my way in thy sight.

texts.NIV84: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.
texts.KJV: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
texts.DRB: for there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain.

texts.NIV84: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
texts.KJV: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
texts.NASB95:
Hold them guilty, O God;
By their own devices let them fall!
In the multitude of their transgressions thrust them out,
For they are rebellious against You.
texts.NKJV:
Pronounce them guilty, O God!
Let them fall by their own counsels;
Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions,
For they have rebelled against You.
texts.DRB: Their throat is an open sepulchre: they dealt deceitfully with their tongues: judge them, O God. Let them fall from their devices: according to the multitude of their wickedness cast them out: for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

texts.NIV84: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.
texts.KJV: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
texts.NASB95:
But let all who take refuge in You be glad,
Let them ever sing for joy;
And may You shelter them,
That those who love Your name may exult in You.
texts.DRB: But let all them be glad that hope in thee: they shall rejoice for ever, and thou shalt dwell in them. And all they that love thy name shall glory in thee:

texts.NIV84: For surely, O LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.
texts.KJV: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
texts.NASB95:
For it is You who blesses the righteous man, O Lord,
You surround him with favor as with a shield.
texts.NKJV:
For You, O Lord, will bless the righteous;
With favor You will surround him as with a shield.
texts.DRB: For thou wilt bless the just. O Lord, thou hast crowned us, as with a shield of thy good will.
texts.ESV:
For you bless the righteous, O Lord;
    you cover him with favor as with a shield.

blocks.title: A Prayer of Faith in Time of Distress

texts.NIV84: O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
texts.KJV: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your anger,
Nor chasten me in Your wrath.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your anger,
Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, in verses, a psalm for David, for the octave. O Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, nor chastise me in thy wrath.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger,
    nor discipline me in your wrath.

texts.NIV84: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am faint; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are in agony.
texts.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am pining away;
Heal me, O Lord, for my bones are dismayed.
texts.NKJV:
Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak;
O Lord, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
texts.DRB: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.
texts.ESV:
Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am languishing;
    heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

texts.NIV84: My soul is in anguish. How long, O LORD, how long?
texts.KJV: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?
texts.NASB95:
And my soul is greatly dismayed;
But You, O Lord—how long?
texts.NKJV:
My soul also is greatly troubled;
But You, O Lord—how long?
texts.DRB: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: but thou, O Lord, how long?
texts.ESV:
My soul also is greatly troubled.
    But you, O Lord—how long?

texts.NIV84: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.
texts.KJV: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
texts.NASB95:
Return, O Lord, rescue my soul;
Save me because of Your lovingkindness.
texts.NKJV:
Return, O Lord, deliver me!
Oh, save me for Your mercies’ sake!
texts.DRB: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: O save me for thy mercy's sake.
texts.ESV:
Turn, O Lord, deliver my life;
    save me for the sake of your steadfast love.

texts.NIV84: No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave?
texts.KJV: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
texts.NASB95:
For there is no mention of You in death;
In Sheol who will give You thanks?
texts.NKJV:
For in death there is no remembrance of You;
In the grave who will give You thanks?
texts.DRB: For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: and who shall confess to thee in hell?
texts.ESV:
For in death there is no remembrance of you;
    in Sheol who will give you praise?

texts.NIV84: I am worn out from groaning; all night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
texts.KJV: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
texts.DRB: I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: I will water my couch with my tears.

texts.NIV84: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.
texts.KJV: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
texts.NASB95:
My eye has wasted away with grief;
It has become old because of all my adversaries.
texts.NKJV:
My eye wastes away because of grief;
It grows old because of all my enemies.
texts.DRB: My eye is troubled through indignation: I have grown old amongst all my enemies.
texts.ESV:
My eye wastes away because of grief;
    it grows weak because of all my foes.

texts.NIV84: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
texts.KJV: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
texts.NASB95:
Depart from me, all you who do iniquity,
For the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
texts.NKJV:
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity;
For the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
texts.DRB: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
texts.ESV:
Depart from me, all you workers of evil,
    for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.

texts.NIV84: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
texts.KJV: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.
texts.NASB95:
The Lord has heard my supplication,
The Lord receives my prayer.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord has heard my supplication;
The Lord will receive my prayer.
texts.DRB: The Lord hath heard my supplication: the Lord hath received my prayer.
texts.ESV:
The Lord has heard my plea;
    the Lord accepts my prayer.

texts.NIV84: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
texts.KJV: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
texts.NASB95:
All my enemies will be ashamed and greatly dismayed;
They shall turn back, they will suddenly be ashamed.
texts.NKJV:
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled;
Let them turn back and be ashamed suddenly.
texts.DRB: Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.
texts.ESV:
All my enemies shall be ashamed and greatly troubled;
    they shall turn back and be put to shame in a moment.

texts.NIV84: O LORD my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,
texts.KJV: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
texts.NASB95:
O Lord my God, in You I have taken refuge;
Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
texts.DRB: The psalm of David which he sung to the Lord for the words of Chusi the son of Jemini. [2 Kings 16.] O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.
texts.ESV:
O Lord my God, in you do I take refuge;
    save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,

texts.NIV84: or they will tear me like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
texts.KJV: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
texts.NASB95:
Or he will tear my soul like a lion,
Dragging me away, while there is none to deliver.
texts.NKJV:
Lest they tear me like a lion,
Rending me in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
texts.DRB: Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.
texts.ESV:
lest like a lion they tear my soul apart,
    rending it in pieces, with none to deliver.

texts.NIV84: O LORD my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands-
texts.KJV: O Lord my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
texts.NASB95:
O Lord my God, if I have done this,
If there is injustice in my hands,
texts.NKJV:
O Lord my God, if I have done this:
If there is iniquity in my hands,
texts.DRB: O Lord my God, if I have done this thing, if there be iniquity in my hands:
texts.ESV:
O Lord my God, if I have done this,
    if there is wrong in my hands,

texts.NIV84: if I have done evil to him who is at peace with me or without cause have robbed my foe-
texts.KJV: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
texts.NASB95:
If I have rewarded evil to my friend,
Or have plundered him who without cause was my adversary,
texts.NKJV:
If I have repaid evil to him who was at peace with me,
Or have plundered my enemy without cause,
texts.DRB: If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils, let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.
texts.ESV:
if I have repaid my friend with evil
    or plundered my enemy without cause,

texts.NIV84: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust. Selah
texts.KJV: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
texts.DRB: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and take it, and tread down my life on the earth, and bring down my glory to the dust.

texts.NIV84: Arise, O LORD, in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.
texts.KJV: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
texts.DRB: Rise up, O Lord, in thy anger: and be thou exalted in the borders of my enemies. And arise, O Lord my God, in the precept which thou hast commanded:

texts.NIV84: Let the assembled peoples gather around you. Rule over them from on high;
texts.KJV: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
texts.NASB95:
Let the assembly of the peoples encompass You,
And over them return on high.
texts.NKJV:
So the congregation of the peoples shall surround You;
For their sakes, therefore, return on high.
texts.DRB: and a congregation of people shall surround thee. And for their sakes return thou on high.
texts.ESV:
Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered about you;
    over it return on high.

texts.NIV84: let the LORD judge the peoples. Judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.
texts.KJV: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
texts.NASB95:
The Lord judges the peoples;
Vindicate me, O Lord, according to my righteousness and my integrity that is in me.
texts.DRB: The Lord judgeth the people. Judge me, O Lord, according to my justice, and according to my innocence in me.

texts.NIV84: O righteous God, who searches minds and hearts, bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure.
texts.KJV: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
texts.NASB95:
O let the evil of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous;
For the righteous God tries the hearts and minds.
texts.DRB: The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought: and thou shalt direct the just: the searcher of hearts and reins is God.
texts.ESV:
Oh, let the evil of the wicked come to an end,
    and may you establish the righteous—
you who test the minds and hearts,
    O righteous God!

texts.NIV84: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.
texts.KJV: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
texts.NASB95:
My shield is with God,
Who saves the upright in heart.
texts.NKJV:
My defense is of God,
Who saves the upright in heart.
texts.DRB: Just is my help from the Lord: who saveth the upright of heart.
texts.ESV:
My shield is with God,
    who saves the upright in heart.

texts.NIV84: God is a righteous judge, a God who expresses his wrath every day.
texts.KJV: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
texts.NASB95:
God is a righteous judge,
And a God who has indignation every day.
texts.NKJV:
God is a just judge,
And God is angry with the wicked every day.
texts.DRB: God is a just judge, strong and patient: is he angry every day?
texts.ESV:
God is a righteous judge,
    and a God who feels indignation every day.

texts.NIV84: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.
texts.KJV: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
texts.NASB95:
If a man does not repent, He will sharpen His sword;
He has bent His bow and made it ready.
texts.DRB: Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword: he hath bent his bow and made it ready.
texts.ESV:
If a man does not repent, God will whet his sword;
    he has bent and readied his bow;

texts.NIV84: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.
texts.KJV: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
texts.NASB95:
He has also prepared for Himself deadly weapons;
He makes His arrows fiery shafts.
texts.NKJV:
He also prepares for Himself instruments of death;
He makes His arrows into fiery shafts.
texts.DRB: And in it he hath prepared the instruments of death, he hath made ready his arrows for them that burn.
texts.ESV:
he has prepared for him his deadly weapons,
    making his arrows fiery shafts.

texts.NIV84: He who is pregnant with evil and conceives trouble gives birth to disillusionment.
texts.KJV: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, he travails with wickedness,
And he conceives mischief and brings forth falsehood.
texts.NKJV:
Behold, the wicked brings forth iniquity;
Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood.
texts.DRB: Behold he hath been in labour with injustice; he hath conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity.
texts.ESV:
Behold, the wicked man conceives evil
    and is pregnant with mischief
    and gives birth to lies.

texts.NIV84: He who digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit he has made.
texts.KJV: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
texts.NASB95:
He has dug a pit and hollowed it out,
And has fallen into the hole which he made.
texts.NKJV:
He made a pit and dug it out,
And has fallen into the ditch which he made.
texts.DRB: He hath opened a pit and dug it; and he is fallen into the hole he made.
texts.ESV:
He makes a pit, digging it out,
    and falls into the hole that he has made.

texts.NIV84: The trouble he causes recoils on himself; his violence comes down on his own head.
texts.KJV: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
texts.NASB95:
His mischief will return upon his own head,
And his violence will descend upon his own pate.
texts.NKJV:
His trouble shall return upon his own head,
And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown.
texts.DRB: His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: and his iniquity shall comedown upon his crown.
texts.ESV:
His mischief returns upon his own head,
    and on his own skull his violence descends.

texts.NIV84: I will give thanks to the LORD because of his righteousness and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
texts.KJV: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.
texts.NASB95:
I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness
And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
texts.NKJV:
I will praise the Lord according to His righteousness,
And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
texts.DRB: I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice: and will sing to the name of the Lord the most high.
texts.ESV:
I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his righteousness,
    and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord, the Most High.

texts.NIV84: I will praise you, O LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonders.
texts.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
texts.NASB95:
I will give thanks to the Lord with all my heart;
I will tell of all Your wonders.
texts.NKJV:
I will praise You, O Lord, with my whole heart;
I will tell of all Your marvelous works.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for the hidden things of the Son. A psalm for David. I will give praise to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: I will relate all thy wonders.
texts.ESV:
I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart;
    I will recount all of your wonderful deeds.

texts.NIV84: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
texts.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
texts.NASB95:
I will be glad and exult in You;
I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
texts.NKJV:
I will be glad and rejoice in You;
I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
texts.DRB: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing to thy name, O thou most high.
texts.ESV:
I will be glad and exult in you;
    I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

texts.NIV84: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.
texts.KJV: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
texts.NASB95:
When my enemies turn back,
They stumble and perish before You.
texts.NKJV:
When my enemies turn back,
They shall fall and perish at Your presence.
texts.DRB: When my enemy shall be turned back: they shall be weakened and perish before thy face.
texts.ESV:
When my enemies turn back,
    they stumble and perish before your presence.

texts.NIV84: For you have upheld my right and my cause; you have sat on your throne, judging righteously.
texts.KJV: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
texts.NASB95:
For You have maintained my just cause;
You have sat on the throne judging righteously.
texts.NKJV:
For You have maintained my right and my cause;
You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.
texts.DRB: For thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.
texts.ESV:
For you have maintained my just cause;
    you have sat on the throne, giving righteous judgment.

texts.NIV84: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
texts.KJV: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
texts.NASB95:
You have rebuked the nations, You have destroyed the wicked;
You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
texts.DRB: Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
texts.ESV:
You have rebuked the nations; you have made the wicked perish;
    you have blotted out their name forever and ever.

texts.NIV84: Endless ruin has overtaken the enemy, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.
texts.KJV: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
texts.DRB: The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: and their cities thou hast destroyed. Their memory hath perished with a noise.

texts.NIV84: The LORD reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.
texts.KJV: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
texts.NASB95:
But the Lord abides forever;
He has established His throne for judgment,
texts.NKJV:
But the Lord shall endure forever;

and he judges the world with righteousness;

The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed,

The Lord is a stronghold for the oppressed,

And those who know Your name will put their trust in You;
For You, Lord, have not forsaken those who seek You.

And those who know your name put their trust in you,

Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion;
Declare among the peoples His deeds.
texts.NKJV:
Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion!
Declare His deeds among the people.
texts.DRB: Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: declare his ways among the Gentiles:
texts.ESV:
Sing praises to the Lord, who sits enthroned in Zion!
    Tell among the peoples his deeds!

texts.NIV84: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

He does not forget the cry of the afflicted.
texts.NKJV:
When He avenges blood, He remembers them;
He does not forget the cry of the humble.
texts.DRB: For requiring their blood he hath remembered the: he hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.
texts.ESV:
For he who avenges blood is mindful of them;

Have mercy on me, O Lord!
Consider my trouble from those who hate me,
You who lift me up from the gates of death,
texts.DRB: Have mercy on me, O Lord: see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.
texts.ESV:
Be gracious to me, O Lord!
    See my affliction from those who hate me,
    O you who lift me up from the gates of death,

texts.NIV84: that I may declare your praises in the gates of the Daughter of Zion and there rejoice in your salvation.
texts.KJV: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
texts.NASB95:
That I may tell of all Your praises,
That in the gates of the daughter of Zion
I may rejoice in Your salvation.
texts.NKJV:
That I may tell of all Your praise
In the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will rejoice in Your salvation.

that I may recount all your praises,

    I may rejoice in your salvation.

texts.NIV84: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
texts.KJV: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
texts.NASB95:
The nations have sunk down in the pit which they have made;
In the net which they hid, their own foot has been caught.
texts.NKJV:
The nations have sunk down in the pit which they made;
In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.
texts.DRB: I will rejoice in thy salvation: the Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they have prepared. Their foot hath been taken in the very snare which they hid.
texts.ESV:
The nations have sunk in the pit that they made;
    in the net that they hid, their own foot has been caught.

texts.NIV84: The LORD is known by his justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion. Selah
texts.KJV: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
texts.DRB: The Lord shall be known when he executeth judgments: the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.
texts.ESV:
The Lord has made himself known; he has executed judgment;
    the wicked are snared in the work of their own hands. Higgaion. Selah

texts.NIV84: The wicked return to the grave, all the nations that forget God.
texts.KJV: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

The wicked will return to Sheol,
Even all the nations who forget God.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked shall be turned into hell,
And all the nations that forget God.
texts.DRB: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.
texts.ESV:
The wicked shall return to Sheol,
    all the nations that forget God.

texts.NIV84: But the needy will not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the afflicted ever perish.
texts.KJV: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
texts.NASB95:
For the needy will not always be forgotten,
Nor the hope of the afflicted perish forever.
texts.NKJV:
For the needy shall not always be forgotten;
The expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.
texts.DRB: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.
texts.ESV:
For the needy shall not always be forgotten,
    and the hope of the poor shall not perish forever.

texts.NIV84: Arise, O LORD, let not man triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.
texts.KJV: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
texts.NASB95:
Arise, O Lord, do not let man prevail;
Let the nations be judged before You.
texts.DRB: Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: let the Gentiles be judged in thy sight.
texts.ESV:
Arise, O Lord! Let not man prevail;
    let the nations be judged before you!

texts.NIV84: Strike them with terror, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
texts.KJV: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
Put them in fear, O Lord;
Let the nations know that they are but men. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
Put them in fear, O Lord,
That the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah
texts.DRB: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.
texts.ESV:
Put them in fear, O Lord!
    Let the nations know that they are but men! Selah

texts.NIV84: Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer- it does not rise from deceitful lips.
texts.KJV: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
texts.NASB95:
Hear a just cause, O Lord, give heed to my cry;
Give ear to my prayer, which is not from deceitful lips.
texts.DRB: The prayer of David. Hear, O Lord, my justice: attend to my supplication. Give ear unto my prayer, which proceedeth not from deceitful lips.
texts.ESV:
Hear a just cause, O Lord; attend to my cry!
    Give ear to my prayer from lips free of deceit!

texts.NIV84: May my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.
texts.KJV: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
texts.NASB95:
Let my judgment come forth from Your presence;
Let Your eyes look with equity.
texts.NKJV:
Let my vindication come from Your presence;
Let Your eyes look on the things that are upright.
texts.DRB: Let my judgment come forth from thy countenance: let thy eyes behold the things that are equitable.
texts.ESV:
From your presence let my vindication come!
    Let your eyes behold the right!

texts.NIV84: Though you probe my heart and examine me at night, though you test me, you will find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not sin.
texts.KJV: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
texts.DRB: Thou hast proved my heart, and visited it by night, thou hast tried me by fire: and iniquity hath not been found in me.

texts.NIV84: As for the deeds of men- by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
texts.KJV: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
texts.NASB95:
As for the deeds of men, by the word of Your lips
I have kept from the paths of the violent.
texts.NKJV:
Concerning the works of men,
By the word of Your lips,
I have kept away from the paths of the destroyer.
texts.DRB: That my mouth may not speak the works of men: for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.
texts.ESV:
With regard to the works of man, by the word of your lips
    I have avoided the ways of the violent.

texts.NIV84: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped.
texts.KJV: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
texts.NASB95:
My steps have held fast to Your paths.
My feet have not slipped.
texts.NKJV:
Uphold my steps in Your paths,
That my footsteps may not slip.
texts.DRB: Perfect thou my goings in thy paths: that my footsteps be not moved.
texts.ESV:
My steps have held fast to your paths;
    my feet have not slipped.

texts.NIV84: I call on you, O God, for you will answer me; give ear to me and hear my prayer.
texts.KJV: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
texts.NASB95:
I have called upon You, for You will answer me, O God;
Incline Your ear to me, hear my speech.
texts.NKJV:
I have called upon You, for You will hear me, O God;
Incline Your ear to me, and hear my speech.
texts.DRB: I have cried to thee, for thou, O God, hast heard me: O incline thy ear unto me, and hear my words.
texts.ESV:
I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God;
    incline your ear to me; hear my words.

texts.NIV84: Show the wonder of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.
texts.KJV: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
texts.NASB95:
Wondrously show Your lovingkindness,
O Savior of those who take refuge at Your right hand
From those who rise up against them.
texts.NKJV:
Show Your marvelous lovingkindness by Your right hand,
O You who save those who trust in You
From those who rise up against them.
texts.DRB: Shew forth thy wonderful mercies; thou who savest them that trust in thee.
texts.ESV:
Wondrously show your steadfast love,
    O Savior of those who seek refuge
    from their adversaries at your right hand.

texts.NIV84: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings
texts.KJV: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
texts.NASB95:
Keep me as the apple of the eye;
Hide me in the shadow of Your wings
texts.NKJV:
Keep me as the apple of Your eye;
Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,
texts.DRB: From them that resist thy right hand keep me, as the apple of thy eye. Protect me under the shadow of thy wings.
texts.ESV:
Keep me as the apple of your eye;
    hide me in the shadow of your wings,

texts.NIV84: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

From the wicked who despoil me,
My deadly enemies who surround me.

From the wicked who oppress me,
From my deadly enemies who surround me.
texts.DRB: From the face of the wicked who have afflicted me. My enemies have surrounded my soul:

from the wicked who do me violence,
    my deadly enemies who surround me.

texts.NIV84: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.

texts.NASB95:
They have closed their unfeeling heart,
With their mouth they speak proudly.
texts.NKJV:
They have closed up their fat hearts;
With their mouths they speak proudly.
texts.DRB: they have shut up their fat: their mouth hath spoken proudly.
texts.ESV:
They close their hearts to pity;
    with their mouths they speak arrogantly.

texts.KJV: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
texts.NASB95:
They have now surrounded us in our steps;
They set their eyes to cast us down to the ground.
texts.NKJV:
They have now surrounded us in our steps;
They have set their eyes, crouching down to the earth,
texts.DRB: They have cast me forth and now they have surrounded me: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth.
texts.ESV:
They have now surrounded our steps;
    they set their eyes to cast us to the ground.

texts.NIV84: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a great lion crouching in cover.
texts.KJV: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
texts.NASB95:
He is like a lion that is eager to tear,
And as a young lion lurking in hiding places.
texts.NKJV:
As a lion is eager to tear his prey,
And like a young lion lurking in secret places.
texts.DRB: They have taken me, as a lion prepared for the prey; and as a young lion dwelling in secret places.
texts.ESV:
He is like a lion eager to tear,
    as a young lion lurking in ambush.

texts.NIV84: Rise up, O LORD, confront them, bring them down; rescue me from the wicked by your sword.
texts.KJV: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
texts.NASB95:
Arise, O Lord, confront him, bring him low;
Deliver my soul from the wicked with Your sword,
texts.DRB: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him and supplant him; deliver my soul from the wicked one: thy sword
texts.ESV:
Arise, O Lord! Confront him, subdue him!
    Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

texts.NIV84: O LORD, by your hand save me from such men, from men of this world whose reward is in this life. You still the hunger of those you cherish; their sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
texts.KJV: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
texts.NASB95:
From men with Your hand, O Lord,
From men of the world, whose portion is in this life,
And whose belly You fill with Your treasure;
They are satisfied with children,
And leave their abundance to their babes.
texts.NKJV:
With Your hand from men, O Lord,
From men of the world who have their portion in this life,
And whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure.
They are satisfied with children,
And leave the rest of their possession for their babes.
texts.DRB: from the enemies of thy hand. O Lord, divide them from the few of the earth in their life: their belly is filled from thy hidden stores. They are full of children: and they have left to their little ones the rest of their substance.

texts.NIV84: And I-in righteousness I will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

texts.NASB95:
As for me, I shall behold Your face in righteousness;
I will be satisfied with Your likeness when I awake.
texts.NKJV:
As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness;
I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.
texts.DRB: But as for me, I will appear before thy sight in justice: I shall be satisfied when thy glory shall appear.
texts.ESV:
As for me, I shall behold your face in righteousness;
    when I awake, I shall be satisfied with your likeness.

texts.KJV: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.
texts.NASB95:
Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have walked in my integrity,
And I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.
texts.NKJV:
Vindicate me, O Lord,
For I have walked in my integrity.
I have also trusted in the Lord;
I shall not slip.

texts.NASB95:
Examine me, O Lord, and try me;
Test my mind and my heart.
texts.NKJV:
Examine me, O Lord, and prove me;
Try my mind and my heart.
texts.DRB: Prove me, O Lord, and try me; burn my reins and my heart.
texts.ESV:
Prove me, O Lord, and try me;
    test my heart and my mind.

texts.NIV84: for your love is ever before me, and I walk continually in your truth.

texts.NASB95:
For Your lovingkindness is before my eyes,
And I have walked in Your truth.
texts.NKJV:
For Your lovingkindness is before my eyes,
And I have walked in Your truth.
texts.DRB: For thy mercy is before my eyes; and I am well pleased with thy truth.
texts.ESV:
For your steadfast love is before my eyes,

I do not sit with deceitful men,
Nor will I go with pretenders.
texts.NKJV:
I have not sat with idolatrous mortals,
Nor will I go in with hypocrites.
texts.DRB: I have not sat with the council of vanity: neither will I go in with the doers of unjust things.
texts.ESV:
I do not sit with men of falsehood,
    nor do I consort with hypocrites.

I have hated the assembly of evildoers,
And will not sit with the wicked.
texts.DRB: I have hated the assembly of the malignant; and with the wicked I will not sit.
texts.ESV:
I hate the assembly of evildoers,

texts.NASB95:
I shall wash my hands in innocence,
And I will go about Your altar, O Lord,
texts.NKJV:
I will wash my hands in innocence;
So I will go about Your altar, O Lord,
texts.DRB: I will wash my hands among the innocent; and will compass thy altar, O Lord:
texts.ESV:
I wash my hands in innocence
    and go around your altar, O Lord,

And declare all Your wonders.
texts.NKJV:
That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving,
And tell of all Your wondrous works.
texts.DRB: That I may hear the voice of thy praise: and tell of all thy wondrous works.
texts.ESV:
proclaiming thanksgiving aloud,
    and telling all your wondrous deeds.

And the place where Your glory dwells.
texts.NKJV:
Lord, I have loved the habitation of Your house,
And the place where Your glory dwells.
texts.DRB: I have loved, O Lord, the beauty of thy house; and the place where thy glory dwelleth.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, I love the habitation of your house
    and the place where your glory dwells.

Do not gather my soul with sinners,
Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,

Do not sweep my soul away with sinners,

In whose hands is a sinister scheme,

in whose hands are evil devices,

But as for me, I will walk in my integrity;

My foot stands in an even place;
In the congregations I will bless the Lord.

My foot stands on level ground;

    my rock, be not deaf to me,
lest, if you be silent to me,

Hear the voice of my supplications
