when I lift up my hands
    toward your most holy sanctuary.

texts.NIV84: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.
texts.KJV: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
texts.NASB95:
Do not drag me away with the wicked
And with those who work iniquity,
Who speak peace with their neighbors,
While evil is in their hearts.
texts.NKJV:
Do not take me away with the wicked
And with the workers of iniquity,
Who speak peace to their neighbors,
But evil is in their hearts.
texts.DRB: Draw me not away together with the wicked; and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not: Who speak peace with their neighbour, but evils are in their hearts.
texts.ESV:
Do not drag me off with the wicked,
    with the workers of evil,
who speak peace with their neighbors
    while evil is in their hearts.

texts.NIV84: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back upon them what they deserve.
texts.KJV: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
texts.DRB: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their inventions. According to the works of their hands give thou to them: render to them their reward.

texts.NIV84: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.
texts.KJV: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
texts.NASB95:
Because they do not regard the works of the Lord
Nor the deeds of His hands,
He will tear them down and not build them up.
texts.NKJV:
Because they do not regard the works of the Lord,
Nor the operation of His hands,
He shall destroy them
And not build them up.
texts.DRB: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of his hands: thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.
texts.ESV:
Because they do not regard the works of the Lord
    or the work of his hands,
he will tear them down and build them up no more.

texts.NIV84: Praise be to the LORD, for he has heard my cry for mercy.
texts.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
texts.NASB95:
Blessed be the Lord,
Because He has heard the voice of my supplication.
texts.NKJV:
Blessed be the Lord,
Because He has heard the voice of my supplications!
texts.DRB: Blessed be the Lord, for he hath heard the voice of my supplication.
texts.ESV:
Blessed be the Lord!
    For he has heard the voice of my pleas for mercy.

texts.NIV84: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and I am helped. My heart leaps for joy and I will give thanks to him in song.
texts.KJV: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
texts.DRB: The Lord is my helper and my protector: in him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped. And my flesh hath flourished again, and with my will I will give praise to him.

texts.NIV84: The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.
texts.KJV: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
texts.NASB95:
The Lord is their strength,
And He is a saving defense to His anointed.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord is their strength,
And He is the saving refuge of His anointed.
texts.DRB: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the protector of the salvation of his anointed.
texts.ESV:
The Lord is the strength of his people;
    he is the saving refuge of his anointed.

texts.NIV84: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.
texts.KJV: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
texts.NASB95:
Save Your people and bless Your inheritance;
Be their shepherd also, and carry them forever.
texts.NKJV:
Save Your people,
And bless Your inheritance;
Shepherd them also,
And bear them up forever.
texts.DRB: Save, O Lord, thy people, and bless thy inheritance: and rule them and exalt them for ever.
texts.ESV:
Oh, save your people and bless your heritage!
    Be their shepherd and carry them forever.

texts.NIV84: I will exalt you, O LORD, for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.
texts.KJV: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
texts.NASB95:
I will extol You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up,
And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
texts.NKJV:
I will extol You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up,
And have not let my foes rejoice over me.
texts.DRB: A psalm of a canticle, at the dedication of David's house. I will extol thee, O Lord, for thou hast upheld me: and hast not made my enemies to rejoice over me.
texts.ESV:
I will extol you, O Lord, for you have drawn me up
    and have not let my foes rejoice over me.

texts.NIV84: O LORD my God, I called to you for help and you healed me.
texts.KJV: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord my God,
I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord my God, I cried out to You,
And You healed me.
texts.DRB: O Lord my God, I have cried to thee, and then hast healed me.
texts.ESV:
O Lord my God, I cried to you for help,
    and you have healed me.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, you brought me up from the grave; you spared me from going down into the pit.
texts.KJV: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, You have brought up my soul from Sheol;
You have kept me alive, that I would not go down to the pit.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, You brought my soul up from the grave;
You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
texts.DRB: Thou hast brought forth, O Lord, my soul from hell: thou hast saved me from them that go down into the pit.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, you have brought up my soul from Sheol;
    you restored me to life from among those who go down to the pit.

texts.NIV84: Sing to the LORD, you saints of his; praise his holy name.
texts.KJV: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
texts.NASB95:
Sing praise to the Lord, you His godly ones,
And give thanks to His holy name.
texts.NKJV:
Sing praise to the Lord, you saints of His,
And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.
texts.DRB: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints: and give praise to the memory of his holiness.
texts.ESV:
Sing praises to the Lord, O you his saints,
    and give thanks to his holy name.

texts.NIV84: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may remain for a night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
texts.KJV: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
texts.NASB95:
For His anger is but for a moment,
His favor is for a lifetime;
Weeping may last for the night,
But a shout of joy comes in the morning.
texts.NKJV:
For His anger is but for a moment,
His favor is for life;
Weeping may endure for a night,
But joy comes in the morning.
texts.DRB: For wrath is in his indignation; and life in his good will. In the evening weeping shall have place, and in the morning gladness.
texts.ESV:
For his anger is but for a moment,
    and his favor is for a lifetime.
Weeping may tarry for the night,
    but joy comes with the morning.

texts.NIV84: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."
texts.KJV: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
texts.NASB95:
Now as for me, I said in my prosperity,
“I will never be moved.”
texts.NKJV:
Now in my prosperity I said,
“I shall never be moved.”
texts.DRB: And in my abundance I said: I shall never be moved.
texts.ESV:
As for me, I said in my prosperity,
    “I shall never be moved.”

texts.NIV84: O LORD, when you favored me, you made my mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.
texts.KJV: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, by Your favor You have made my mountain to stand strong;
You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
texts.NKJV:
Lord, by Your favor You have made my mountain stand strong;
You hid Your face, and I was troubled.
texts.DRB: O Lord, in thy favour, thou gavest strength to my beauty. Thou turnedst away thy face from me, and I became troubled.

texts.NIV84: To you, O LORD, I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:
texts.KJV: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.
texts.NASB95:
To You, O Lord, I called,
And to the Lord I made supplication:
texts.NKJV:
I cried out to You, O Lord;
And to the Lord I made supplication:
texts.DRB: To thee, O Lord, will I cry: and I will make supplication to my God.
texts.ESV:
To you, O Lord, I cry,
    and to the Lord I plead for mercy:

texts.NIV84: "What gain is there in my destruction, in my going down into the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?
texts.KJV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
texts.NASB95:
“What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit?
Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your faithfulness?
texts.NKJV:
“What profit is there in my blood,
When I go down to the pit?
Will the dust praise You?
Will it declare Your truth?
texts.DRB: What profit is there in my blood, whilst I go down to corruption? Shall dust confess to thee, or declare thy truth?
texts.ESV:
“What profit is there in my death,
    if I go down to the pit?
Will the dust praise you?
    Will it tell of your faithfulness?

texts.NIV84: Hear, O LORD, and be merciful to me; O LORD, be my help."
texts.KJV: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.
texts.NASB95:
“Hear, O Lord, and be gracious to me;
O Lord, be my helper.”
texts.NKJV:
Hear, O Lord, and have mercy on me;
Lord, be my helper!”
texts.DRB: The Lord hath heard, and hath had mercy on me: the Lord became my helper.
texts.ESV:
Hear, O Lord, and be merciful to me!
    O Lord, be my helper!”

texts.NIV84: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
texts.KJV: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
texts.NASB95:
You have turned for me my mourning into dancing;
You have loosed my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
texts.NKJV:
You have turned for me my mourning into dancing;
You have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,
texts.DRB: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into joy: thou hast cut my sackcloth, and hast compassed me with gladness:

texts.NIV84: that my heart may sing to you and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give you thanks forever.
texts.KJV: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
texts.NASB95:
That my soul may sing praise to You and not be silent.
O Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
texts.NKJV:
To the end that my glory may sing praise to You and not be silent.
O Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
texts.DRB: To the end that my glory may sing to thee, and I may not regret: O Lord my God, I will give praise to thee for ever.
texts.ESV:
that my glory may sing your praise and not be silent.
    O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

blocks.title: The Lord the Avenger of His People

texts.NIV84: Contend, O LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
texts.KJV: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
texts.NASB95:
Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me;
Fight against those who fight against me.
texts.NKJV:
Plead my cause, O Lord, with those who strive with me;
Fight against those who fight against me.
texts.DRB: For David himself. Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me : overthrow them that fight against me.
texts.ESV:
Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me;
    fight against those who fight against me!

texts.NIV84: Take up shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
texts.KJV: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
texts.NASB95:
Take hold of buckler and shield
And rise up for my help.
texts.NKJV:
Take hold of shield and buckler,
And stand up for my help.
texts.DRB: Take hold of arms and shield : and rise up to help me.
texts.ESV:
Take hold of shield and buckler
    and rise for my help!

texts.NIV84: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
texts.KJV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
texts.NASB95:
Draw also the spear and the battle-axe to meet those who pursue me;
Say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
texts.NKJV:
Also draw out the spear,
And stop those who pursue me.
Say to my soul,
“I am your salvation.”
texts.DRB: Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me : say to my soul : I am thy salvation.
texts.ESV:
Draw the spear and javelin
    against my pursuers!
Say to my soul,
    “I am your salvation!”

texts.NIV84: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.
texts.KJV: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
texts.NASB95:
Let those be ashamed and dishonored who seek my life;
Let those be turned back and humiliated who devise evil against me.
texts.NKJV:
Let those be put to shame and brought to dishonor
Who seek after my life;
Let those be turned back and brought to confusion
Who plot my hurt.
texts.DRB: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and be confounded that devise against me.
texts.ESV:
Let them be put to shame and dishonor
    who seek after my life!
Let them be turned back and disappointed
    who devise evil against me!

texts.NIV84: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away;
texts.KJV: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.
texts.NASB95:
Let them be like chaff before the wind,
With the angel of the Lord driving them on.
texts.NKJV:
Let them be like chaff before the wind,
And let the angel of the Lord chase them.
texts.DRB: Let them become as dust before the wind : and let the angel of the Lord straiten them.
texts.ESV:
Let them be like chaff before the wind,
    with the angel of the Lord driving them away!

texts.NIV84: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
texts.KJV: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
texts.NASB95:
Let their way be dark and slippery,
With the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
texts.NKJV:
Let their way be dark and slippery,
And let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
texts.DRB: Let their way become dark and slippery; and let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
texts.ESV:
Let their way be dark and slippery,
    with the angel of the Lord pursuing them!

texts.NIV84: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,
texts.KJV: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
texts.NASB95:
For without cause they hid their net for me;
Without cause they dug a pit for my soul.
texts.NKJV:
For without cause they have hidden their net for me in a pit,
Which they have dug without cause for my life.
texts.DRB: For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction : without cause they have upbraided my soul.
texts.ESV:
For without cause they hid their net for me;
    without cause they dug a pit for my life.

texts.NIV84: may ruin overtake them by surprise- may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.
texts.KJV: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
texts.DRB: Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him : and let the net which he hath hidden catch him : and let the net which he hath hidden catch him : and into that very snare let them fall.

texts.NIV84: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in his salvation.
texts.KJV: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
texts.NASB95:
And my soul shall rejoice in the Lord;
It shall exult in His salvation.
texts.NKJV:
And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord;
It shall rejoice in His salvation.
texts.DRB: But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; and shall be delighted in his salvation.
texts.ESV:
Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord,
    exulting in his salvation.

texts.NIV84: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, O LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."
texts.KJV: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
texts.NASB95:
All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like You,
Who delivers the afflicted from him who is too strong for him,
And the afflicted and the needy from him who robs him?”
texts.NKJV:
All my bones shall say,
“Lord, who is like You,
Delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him,
Yes, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?”
texts.DRB: All my bones shall say : Lord, who is like to thee? Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; the needy and the poor from them that strip him.
texts.ESV:
All my bones shall say,
    “O Lord, who is like you,
delivering the poor
    from him who is too strong for him,
    the poor and needy from him who robs him?”

texts.NIV84: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.
texts.KJV: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
texts.NASB95:
Malicious witnesses rise up;
They ask me of things that I do not know.
texts.NKJV:
Fierce witnesses rise up;
They ask me things that I do not know.
texts.DRB: Unjust witnesses rising up have asked me things I knew not.
texts.ESV:
Malicious witnesses rise up;
    they ask me of things that I do not know.

texts.NIV84: They repay me evil for good and leave my soul forlorn.
texts.KJV: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
texts.NASB95:
They repay me evil for good,
To the bereavement of my soul.
texts.NKJV:
They reward me evil for good,
To the sorrow of my soul.
texts.DRB: They repaid me evil for good : to the depriving me of my soul.
texts.ESV:
They repay me evil for good;
    my soul is bereft.

texts.NIV84: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,
texts.KJV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
texts.DRB: But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, I was clothed with haircloth. I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

texts.NIV84: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.
texts.KJV: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
texts.NASB95:
I went about as though it were my friend or brother;
I bowed down mourning, as one who sorrows for a mother.
texts.NKJV:
I paced about as though he were my friend or brother;
I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother.
texts.DRB: As a neighbour and as an own brother, so did I please : as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

texts.NIV84: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; attackers gathered against me when I was unaware. They slandered me without ceasing.
texts.KJV: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
texts.DRB: But they rejoiced against me, and came together : scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

texts.NIV84: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.
texts.KJV: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
texts.NASB95:
Like godless jesters at a feast,
They gnashed at me with their teeth.
texts.NKJV:
With ungodly mockers at feasts
They gnashed at me with their teeth.
texts.DRB: They were separated, and repented not : they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn : they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
texts.ESV:
like profane mockers at a feast,
    they gnash at me with their teeth.

texts.NIV84: O Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
texts.KJV: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
texts.NASB95:
Lord, how long will You look on?
Rescue my soul from their ravages,
My only life from the lions.
texts.NKJV:
Lord, how long will You look on?
Rescue me from their destructions,
My precious life from the lions.
texts.DRB: Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? rescue thou soul from their malice : my only one from the lions.
texts.ESV:
How long, O Lord, will you look on?
    Rescue me from their destruction,
    my precious life from the lions!

texts.NIV84: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among throngs of people I will praise you.
texts.KJV: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
texts.NASB95:
I will give You thanks in the great congregation;
I will praise You among a mighty throng.
texts.NKJV:
I will give You thanks in the great assembly;
I will praise You among many people.
texts.DRB: I will give thanks to thee in a great church; I will praise thee in a strong people.
texts.ESV:
I will thank you in the great congregation;
    in the mighty throng I will praise you.

texts.NIV84: Let not those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; let not those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.
texts.KJV: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
texts.NASB95:
Do not let those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me;
Nor let those who hate me without cause wink maliciously.
texts.NKJV:
Let them not rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies;
Nor let them wink with the eye who hate me without a cause.
texts.DRB: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me : who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.
texts.ESV:
Let not those rejoice over me
    who are wrongfully my foes,
and let not those wink the eye
    who hate me without cause.

texts.NIV84: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.
texts.KJV: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
texts.NASB95:
For they do not speak peace,
But they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
texts.NKJV:
For they do not speak peace,
But they devise deceitful matters
Against the quiet ones in the land.
texts.DRB: For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.
texts.ESV:
For they do not speak peace,
    but against those who are quiet in the land
    they devise words of deceit.

texts.NIV84: They gape at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."
texts.KJV: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
texts.NASB95:
They opened their mouth wide against me;
They said, “Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it!”
texts.NKJV:
They also opened their mouth wide against me,
And said, “Aha, aha!
Our eyes have seen it.”
texts.DRB: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said : Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, you have seen this; be not silent. Do not be far from me, O Lord.
texts.KJV: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
texts.NASB95:
You have seen it, O Lord, do not keep silent;
O Lord, do not be far from me.
texts.DRB: Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not thou silent : O Lord, depart not from me.
texts.ESV:
You have seen, O Lord; be not silent!
    O Lord, be not far from me!

texts.NIV84: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.
texts.KJV: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
texts.NASB95:
Stir up Yourself, and awake to my right
And to my cause, my God and my Lord.
texts.NKJV:
Stir up Yourself, and awake to my vindication,
To my cause, my God and my Lord.
texts.DRB: Arise, and be attentive to my judgment : to my cause, my God, and my Lord.
texts.ESV:
Awake and rouse yourself for my vindication,
    for my cause, my God and my Lord!

texts.NIV84: Vindicate me in your righteousness, O LORD my God; do not let them gloat over me.
texts.KJV: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
texts.NASB95:
Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Your righteousness,
And do not let them rejoice over me.
texts.NKJV:
Vindicate me, O Lord my God, according to Your righteousness;
And let them not rejoice over me.
texts.DRB: Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, and let them not rejoice over me.
texts.ESV:
Vindicate me, O Lord, my God,
    according to your righteousness,
    and let them not rejoice over me!

texts.NIV84: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."
texts.KJV: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
texts.NASB95:
Do not let them say in their heart, “Aha, our desire!”
Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
texts.NKJV:
Let them not say in their hearts, “Ah, so we would have it!”
Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”
texts.DRB: Let them not say in their hearts : It is well, it is well, to our mind : neither let them say : We have swallowed him up.
texts.ESV:
Let them not say in their hearts,
    “Aha, our heart's desire!”
Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”

texts.NIV84: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
texts.KJV: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
texts.NASB95:
Let those be ashamed and humiliated altogether who rejoice at my distress;
Let those be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves over me.
texts.NKJV:
Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion
Who rejoice at my hurt;
Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor
Who exalt themselves against me.
texts.DRB: Let them blush : and be ashamed together, who rejoice at my evils. Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, who speak great things against me.
texts.ESV:
Let them be put to shame and disappointed altogether
    who rejoice at my calamity!
Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor
    who magnify themselves against me!

texts.NIV84: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The LORD be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant."
texts.KJV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
texts.NKJV:
Let them shout for joy and be glad,
Who favor my righteous cause;
And let them say continually,
“Let the Lord be magnified,
Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant.”
texts.DRB: Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, and let them say always : The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.
texts.ESV:
Let those who delight in my righteousness
    shout for joy and be glad
    and say evermore,
“Great is the Lord,
    who delights in the welfare of his servant!”

texts.NIV84: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praises all day long.
texts.KJV: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
texts.NASB95:
And my tongue shall declare Your righteousness
And Your praise all day long.
texts.NKJV:
And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness
And of Your praise all the day long.
texts.DRB: Any my tongue shall meditate thy justice, thy praise all the day long.
texts.ESV:
Then my tongue shall tell of your righteousness
    and of your praise all the day long.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
texts.KJV: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, rebuke me not in Your wrath,
And chasten me not in Your burning anger.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your wrath,
Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure!
texts.DRB: A psalm for David, for a remembrance of the sabbath. Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; nor chastise me in thy wrath.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger,
    nor discipline me in your wrath!

texts.NIV84: For your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down upon me.
texts.KJV: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
texts.NASB95:
For Your arrows have sunk deep into me,
And Your hand has pressed down on me.
texts.NKJV:
For Your arrows pierce me deeply,
And Your hand presses me down.
texts.DRB: For thy arrows are fastened in me : and thy hand hath been strong upon me.
texts.ESV:
For your arrows have sunk into me,
    and your hand has come down on me.

texts.NIV84: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; my bones have no soundness because of my sin.
texts.KJV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
texts.NASB95:
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation;
There is no health in my bones because of my sin.
texts.NKJV:
There is no soundness in my flesh
Because of Your anger,
Nor any health in my bones
Because of my sin.
texts.DRB: There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath : there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.
texts.ESV:
There is no soundness in my flesh
    because of your indignation;
there is no health in my bones
    because of my sin.

texts.NIV84: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
texts.KJV: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
texts.NASB95:
For my iniquities are gone over my head;
As a heavy burden they weigh too much for me.
texts.NKJV:
For my iniquities have gone over my head;
Like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
texts.DRB: For my iniquities are gone over my head : and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.
texts.ESV:
For my iniquities have gone over my head;
    like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

texts.NIV84: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.
texts.KJV: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
texts.NASB95:
My wounds grow foul and fester
Because of my folly.
texts.NKJV:
My wounds are foul and festering
Because of my foolishness.
texts.DRB: My sores are putrified and corrupted, because of my foolishness.
texts.ESV:
My wounds stink and fester
    because of my foolishness,

texts.NIV84: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.
texts.KJV: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
texts.NASB95:
I am bent over and greatly bowed down;
I go mourning all day long.
texts.NKJV:
I am troubled, I am bowed down greatly;
I go mourning all the day long.
texts.DRB: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end : I walked sorrowful all the day long.
texts.ESV:
I am utterly bowed down and prostrate;
    all the day I go about mourning.

texts.NIV84: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.
texts.KJV: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
texts.NASB95:
For my loins are filled with burning,
And there is no soundness in my flesh.
texts.NKJV:
For my loins are full of inflammation,
And there is no soundness in my flesh.
texts.DRB: For my loins are filled with illusions; and there is no health in my flesh.
texts.ESV:
For my sides are filled with burning,
    and there is no soundness in my flesh.

texts.NIV84: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
texts.KJV: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
texts.NASB95:
I am benumbed and badly crushed;
I groan because of the agitation of my heart.
texts.NKJV:
I am feeble and severely broken;
I groan because of the turmoil of my heart.
texts.DRB: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly : I roared with the groaning of my heart.
texts.ESV:
I am feeble and crushed;
    I groan because of the tumult of my heart.

texts.NIV84: All my longings lie open before you, O Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.
texts.KJV: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
texts.NASB95:
Lord, all my desire is before You;
And my sighing is not hidden from You.
texts.NKJV:
Lord, all my desire is before You;
And my sighing is not hidden from You.
texts.DRB: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my groaning is not hidden from thee.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, all my longing is before you;
    my sighing is not hidden from you.

texts.NIV84: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.
texts.KJV: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
texts.NASB95:
My heart throbs, my strength fails me;
And the light of my eyes, even that has gone from me.
texts.NKJV:
My heart pants, my strength fails me;
As for the light of my eyes, it also has gone from me.
texts.DRB: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.
texts.ESV:
My heart throbs; my strength fails me,
    and the light of my eyes—it also has gone from me.

texts.NIV84: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.
texts.KJV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
texts.NASB95:
My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague;
And my kinsmen stand afar off.
texts.NKJV:
My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague,
And my relatives stand afar off.
texts.DRB: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me. And they that were near me stood afar off :
texts.ESV:
My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague,
    and my nearest kin stand far off.

texts.NIV84: Those who seek my life set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they plot deception.
texts.KJV: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
texts.DRB: And they that sought my soul used violence. And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, and studied deceits all the day long.

texts.NIV84: I am like a deaf man, who cannot hear, like a mute, who cannot open his mouth;
texts.KJV: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
texts.NASB95:
But I, like a deaf man, do not hear;
And I am like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
texts.NKJV:
But I, like a deaf man, do not hear;
And I am like a mute who does not open his mouth.
texts.DRB: But I, as a deaf man, heard not : and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.
texts.ESV:
But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear,
    like a mute man who does not open his mouth.

texts.NIV84: I have become like a man who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.
texts.KJV: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
texts.NASB95:
Yes, I am like a man who does not hear,
And in whose mouth are no arguments.
texts.NKJV:
Thus I am like a man who does not hear,
And in whose mouth is no response.
texts.DRB: And I became as a man that heareth not : and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.
texts.ESV:
I have become like a man who does not hear,
    and in whose mouth are no rebukes.

texts.NIV84: I wait for you, O LORD; you will answer, O Lord my God.
texts.KJV: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
texts.NASB95:
For I hope in You, O Lord;
You will answer, O Lord my God.
texts.NKJV:
For in You, O Lord, I hope;
You will hear, O Lord my God.
texts.DRB: For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped : thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.
texts.ESV:
But for you, O Lord, do I wait;
    it is you, O Lord my God, who will answer.

texts.NIV84: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."
texts.KJV: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
texts.NASB95:
For I said, “May they not rejoice over me,
Who, when my foot slips, would magnify themselves against me.”
texts.NKJV:
For I said, “Hear me, lest they rejoice over me,
Lest, when my foot slips, they exalt themselves against me.”
texts.DRB: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me : and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.
texts.ESV:
For I said, “Only let them not rejoice over me,
    who boast against me when my foot slips!”

texts.NIV84: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
texts.KJV: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
texts.NASB95:
For I am ready to fall,
And my sorrow is continually before me.
texts.NKJV:
For I am ready to fall,
And my sorrow is continually before me.
texts.DRB: For I am ready for scourges : and my sorrow is continually before me.
texts.ESV:
For I am ready to fall,
    and my pain is ever before me.

texts.NIV84: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
texts.KJV: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
texts.NASB95:
For I confess my iniquity;
I am full of anxiety because of my sin.
texts.NKJV:
For I will declare my iniquity;
I will be in anguish over my sin.
texts.DRB: For I will declare my inequity : and I will think for my sin.
texts.ESV:
I confess my iniquity;
    I am sorry for my sin.

texts.NIV84: Many are those who are my vigorous enemies; those who hate me without reason are numerous.
texts.KJV: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
texts.NASB95:
But my enemies are vigorous and strong,
And many are those who hate me wrongfully.
texts.NKJV:
But my enemies are vigorous, and they are strong;
And those who hate me wrongfully have multiplied.
texts.DRB: But my enemies live, and are stronger that I : and they hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
texts.ESV:
But my foes are vigorous, they are mighty,
    and many are those who hate me wrongfully.

texts.NIV84: Those who repay my good with evil slander me when I pursue what is good.
texts.KJV: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
texts.NASB95:
And those who repay evil for good,
They oppose me, because I follow what is good.
texts.NKJV:
Those also who render evil for good,
They are my adversaries, because I follow what is good.
texts.DRB: They that render evil for good, have detracted me, because I followed goodness.
texts.ESV:
Those who render me evil for good
    accuse me because I follow after good.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, do not forsake me; be not far from me, O my God.
texts.KJV: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.
texts.NASB95:
Do not forsake me, O Lord;
O my God, do not be far from me!
texts.NKJV:
Do not forsake me, O Lord;
O my God, be not far from me!
texts.DRB: Forsake me not, O Lord my God : do not thou depart from me.
texts.ESV:
Do not forsake me, O Lord!
    O my God, be not far from me!

texts.NIV84: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
texts.KJV: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
texts.NASB95:
Make haste to help me,
O Lord, my salvation!
texts.NKJV:
Make haste to help me,
O Lord, my salvation!
texts.DRB: Attend unto my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation.
texts.ESV:
Make haste to help me,
    O Lord, my salvation!

texts.NIV84: I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence."
texts.KJV: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
texts.NASB95:
I said, “I will guard my ways
That I may not sin with my tongue;
I will guard my mouth as with a muzzle
While the wicked are in my presence.”
texts.NKJV:
I said, “I will guard my ways,
Lest I sin with my tongue;
I will restrain my mouth with a muzzle,
While the wicked are before me.”
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for Idithun himself, a canticle of David. I said: I will take heed to my ways : that I sin not with my tongue. I have set guard to my mouth, when the sinner stood against me.
texts.ESV:
I said, “I will guard my ways,
    that I may not sin with my tongue;
I will guard my mouth with a muzzle,
    so long as the wicked are in my presence.”

texts.NIV84: But when I was silent and still, not even saying anything good, my anguish increased.
texts.KJV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
texts.NASB95:
I was mute and silent,
I refrained even from good,
And my sorrow grew worse.
texts.DRB: I was dumb, and was humbled, and kept silence from good things : and my sorrow was renewed.

texts.NIV84: My heart grew hot within me, and as I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
texts.KJV: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
texts.DRB: My heart grew hot within me : and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.

texts.NIV84: "Show me, O LORD, my life's end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting is my life.
texts.KJV: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
texts.NKJV:
“Lord, make me to know my end,
And what is the measure of my days,
That I may know how frail I am.
texts.DRB: I spoke with my tongue : O Lord, make me know my end. And what is the number of my days : that I may know what is wanting to me.

texts.NIV84: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Each man's life is but a breath. Selah
texts.KJV: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
texts.DRB: Behold thou hast made my days measurable : and my substance is as nothing before thee. And indeed all things are vanity : every man living.
texts.ESV:
Behold, you have made my days a few handbreadths,
    and my lifetime is as nothing before you.
Surely all mankind stands as a mere breath! Selah

texts.NIV84: Man is a mere phantom as he goes to and fro: He bustles about, but only in vain; he heaps up wealth, not knowing who will get it.
texts.KJV: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
texts.DRB: Surely man passeth as an image : yea, and he is disquieted in vain. He storeth up : and he knoweth not for whom he shall gather these things.

texts.NIV84: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.
texts.KJV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
texts.NASB95:
“And now, Lord, for what do I wait?
My hope is in You.
texts.NKJV:
“And now, Lord, what do I wait for?
My hope is in You.
texts.DRB: And now what is my hope? is it not the Lord? and my substance is with thee.
texts.ESV:
“And now, O Lord, for what do I wait?
    My hope is in you.

texts.NIV84: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.
texts.KJV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
texts.NASB95:
“Deliver me from all my transgressions;
Make me not the reproach of the foolish.
texts.NKJV:
Deliver me from all my transgressions;
Do not make me the reproach of the foolish.
texts.DRB: Deliver thou me from all my iniquities : thou hast made me a reproach to the fool.
texts.ESV:
Deliver me from all my transgressions.
    Do not make me the scorn of the fool!

texts.NIV84: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.
texts.KJV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
texts.NASB95:
“I have become mute, I do not open my mouth,
Because it is You who have done it.
texts.NKJV:
I was mute, I did not open my mouth,
Because it was You who did it.
texts.DRB: I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because thou hast done it.
texts.ESV:
I am mute; I do not open my mouth,
    for it is you who have done it.

texts.NIV84: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
texts.KJV: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
texts.NASB95:
“Remove Your plague from me;
Because of the opposition of Your hand I am perishing.
texts.NKJV:
Remove Your plague from me;
I am consumed by the blow of Your hand.
texts.DRB: Remove thy scourges from me. The strength of thy hand hath made me faint in rebukes:
texts.ESV:
Remove your stroke from me;
    I am spent by the hostility of your hand.

texts.NIV84: You rebuke and discipline men for their sin; you consume their wealth like a moth- each man is but a breath. Selah
texts.KJV: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
texts.DRB: thou hast corrected man for iniquity. And thou hast made his soul to waste away like a spider : surely in vain is any man disquieted.
texts.ESV:
When you discipline a man
    with rebukes for sin,
you consume like a moth what is dear to him;
    surely all mankind is a mere breath! Selah

texts.NIV84: "Hear my prayer, O LORD, listen to my cry for help; be not deaf to my weeping. For I dwell with you as an alien, a stranger, as all my fathers were.
texts.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
texts.DRB: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and my supplication : give ear to my tears. Be not silent : for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner as all my fathers were.
texts.ESV:
“Hear my prayer, O Lord,
    and give ear to my cry;
    hold not your peace at my tears!
For I am a sojourner with you,
    a guest, like all my fathers.

texts.NIV84: Look away from me, that I may rejoice again before I depart and am no more."
texts.KJV: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
texts.NASB95:
“Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may smile again
Before I depart and am no more.”
texts.NKJV:
Remove Your gaze from me, that I may regain strength,
Before I go away and am no more.”
texts.DRB: O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, and be no more.
texts.ESV:
Look away from me, that I may smile again,
    before I depart and am no more!”
